title: One Final Relic
objectives: Travel to the [[Burning Steppes]] and meet with the [[Sons of Lothar]].
Let Alonsus know you are ready
Head to the Burning Steppes to meet with the Sons of Lothar.
description:
<Name>, I've asked the [[Sons of Lothar]] to meet us in the [[Burning Steppes]] near [[Blackrock Mountain]]. There's [[Turalyon's shield|one more item]] we must recover there.

We can depart as soon as you are ready.
progress: Good trip?
completion:
It seems we have more to do here than just finding a relic.

This area is overrun with a group that calls themselves the "[[Dark Horde]]." and we are going to put a stop to their activities.
next: [[The Dark Horde]], [[None Left Standing]], & [[Faithful Servant, Faithless Cause]]

title: The Dark Horde
description:
I once served under [[Blackhand]], long ago. His son [[Dal'rend Blackhand|Rend]] was a sniveling fool: a coward who bolstered himself in that Spire after Doomhammer was defeated. He made deals with dragons, called himself Warchief, and proclaimed his Dark Horde the 'true' Horde. Pah!

This Dark Horde embraces the ideals of a past long gone. Rend died [[Rend Blackhand (tactics)|years ago]], but there are still orcs and ogres here who cling to the rotting husk that remains.

If they haven't seen the truth by now. there is little hope for them but death.
progress: How goes the battle, <name>?
completion: Perhaps, in the face of the death of their comrades, others will see sense as I did. At least those you killed won't dishonor themselves any longer.

title: None Left Standing
description:
The one thing worse than seeing this Dark Horde here is their banners.

It showcases their pride in this accursed mountain as a place of greatness--as a place for their horde to rise. In reality, this banner is little more than a defiled perversion of the ancestral Blackrock sigil.

Burn down every one you find.
progress: Got those banners dealt with, <name>?
completion:
I hope that this might demoralize some of these soldiers out of their misguided devotion to a failed cause.

Regardless, I am glad those banners are not flying any longer.

title: Faithful Servant, Faithless Cause
objectives: {{questportrait|Mar'kag.jpg|Mar'kag|Mar'kag has long served the [[Dark Horde]], and now leads their [[ogre]]s. It is time he was rewarded for his contributions.}}
description:
One of their lieutenants, Mar'kag, appears to be the one barking orders. His father, [[Highlord Omokk|High Overlord Omokk]], followed under [[Dal'rend Blackhand|Rend Blackhand]]'s banner. Cruel, vicious... no surprise that his son follows in his footsteps.

Taking Mar'kag down will spread chaos among the cowardly remnants of this [[Dark Horde]] and perhaps help them realize they are not as strong as they think.

[[Alonsus Faol|Faol]] also has us here to look for relic fragments. If Mar'kag has anything of note, bring it back.
progress: Did you put a stop to Mar'kag, <name>?
completion:
As we defeat their leaders, the Dark Horde presence throughout the Burning Steppes will continue to splinter.

Mar'kag was the first to fall. This was a good first step.
rewards:
You will receive one of:
*[[Mar'kag's Handless Gloves]]
*[[Mar'kag's Anklet]]
*[[Mar'kag's Bracers]]
*[[Mar'kag's Oversized Ring]]

You will also receive:
*{{cost|46|80}}
*15,200 [[XP]]

title: Still Scouting
description:
When the [[Alliance]] originally [[Siege of Blackrock Spire|fought]] the Horde here, Kurdran served as a scout. He's still an excellent one. He took [[Sky'reen|his gryphon]] to Blackrock Mountain to see what kind of forces we may be dealing with there.

Meet up with him and see what kind of trouble you can cause.
completion: Arator, <name>--thanks fer coming. Plenty o' Dark Horde in there.
prev: [[The Dark Horde]], [[None Left Standing]], & [[Faithful Servant, Faithless Cause]]
next: [[Due Recognition]], [[Nagosh the Scarred (quest)]], & [[Disarm the Dark Horde]]

title: Due Recognition
objectives: Retrieve Stone Guard badges from the Dark Horde in Blackrock Mountain.
description:
[[Blackrock Mountain]] is where most of the [[Dark Horde]] has holed up. All their unit commanders adorn themselves with badges, struttin' around like they won the [[Second War]]. Shameful! But it gives me an idea.

Defeat them and take their badges. Can't have new leaders that way--these blowhards like the pomp of command. Who wants the stress of leadership with no fancy badge to wear?

Head on in there with [[Arator the Redeemer|Arator]] and keep 'em busy. [[Sky'reen]] an' I will support ye from the air.
progress: Did ye get their badges, <name>?
completion:
That gave 'em a kick in the pants!

See if any of 'em volunteer to lead their warbands now, after that humiliation!

title: Disarm the Dark Horde
description:
The [[Dark Horde]] have no love fer their equipment. Look at their weapons! Cracked, rusted, blunt, and bent. Ach! 

The only way they function is by making more shoddy tools to constantly replace the ones they've broken.

If ye see any of their weapon racks, destroy 'em. Let's see how well they fight without their rusty blades.

A bare-fisted [[orc]] is nothing to sneeze at, but it'll further delay any daft plans they've got.
progress: Get those taken care of, <name>?
completion:
Did ye destroy their weapons racks?

Aye, that'll do. We've bought everyone nearby a few months of peace while they resupply.

title: Nagosh the Scarred
objectives: {{questportrait|Nagosh the Scarred.jpg|Nagosh the Scarred|Nagosh charges his enemies fiercely and fearlessly. While his strategy is not safe, it is quite effective.}}
description:
The [[Dark Horde]] may strut around inside the mountain, but an orc called Nagosh is the one rulin' this roost.

He barks orders, then charges straight into a fight. Rock-heads in command like that one are what gets everyone on all sides killed.

I'd bet anything that numbskull claimed [[Alonsus Faol|Faol]]'s [[Turalyon's shield|shiny relic]]. Keep an eye out. He may jump ye in the middle of a fight.
progress: Did ye put a stop to Nagosh?
completion:
Did ye get Faol's relic?

I hope that old priest knows what he's doing.
rewards:
You will receive one of:
*[[Scarred Blackrock Choker]]
*[[Medallion of the Dark Horde]]

You will also receive:
*{{cost|46|80}}
*15,200 [[XP]]

title: Not Just a Troll's Bane
description:
As much as I'd love to keep harassing these [[Dark Horde]] grunts, we've found the relic piece that [[Alonsus Faol|Faol]] wanted us to. We best be getting on.

Danath went looking for the last piece of the relic. You go find him, and I'll tell the mad bishop that his plan is nearly complete. Find me at [[Anduin Lothar|Lothar]]'s Statue when yer done.
completion: <Name>, [[Arator Windrunner|Arator]]--good to see you. I believe I have a solution to our problem.
prev: [[Due Recognition]], [[Nagosh the Scarred (quest)]], & [[Disarm the Dark Horde]]
next: [[Warriors Without a Warlord]] & [[A True Horde of Dark Horde]]

title: Warriors Without a Warlord
objectives: {{questportrait|Warlord Grazla.jpg|Warlord Grazla|Warlord Grazla has commanded the Dark Horde long enough.}}
Enter Blackrock Stronghold and take out the leader of the Dark Horde.
description:
Despite our work in the area, the Dark Horde continues to battle. Their leader is there, in Blackrock Stronghold, likely bolstering their spirits.

Take them out. Once we do, I suspect this Dark Horde will come to nothing, with much less bloodshed.

And Faol thinks there may be a fragment of [[Turalyon's shield|the relic]] he's looking for in there. Recover that as well!
progress: Have you taken them out?
completion: Excellent, <name>! I believe this will save many lives across the region. With no warlord to rally them, the Dark Horde should fall apart.
rewards:
You will receive one of:
* [[Dark Horde Circle]]
* [[Dark Horde Cowl]]
* [[Dark Horde Helm]]
* [[Dark Horde Helmet]]

You will also receive:
* {{cost|46|80}}
* 15,200 [[XP]]

title: A True Horde of Dark Horde
objectives: Defeat 12 [[Dark Horde]] troops and 3 Dark Horde Sergeants.
description:
The remaining Dark Horde forces are gathered here, <name>. Many of them look to be untrained and new to the cause.

Drive away the forces gathered here, and perhaps we can hope to see some peace in this region--for the first time in decades.
progress: You've made a good start, <name>, with Arator's help.
completion:
You killed many of them, but I watched even more run away.

Let's hope they never return.

title: A Landmark Moment
objectives: Meet the [[Sons of Lothar]] at [[Lothar's Statue]].
description:
With their leader defeated and that third relic fragment found, we should regroup with the others back at Lothar's Statue, <name>.

I'll meet you there.
completion: These fragments you've been recovering might be the most important relics of our journey, <name>.
prev: [[Warriors Without a Warlord]] & [[A True Horde of Dark Horde]]

title: Unstoppable Force
objectives: Ask Kurdran about the events of that day.
description:
This statue seems out of place here. Nothing else like it. But this is where [[Anduin Lothar]] fell against [[Orgrim Doomhammer]] at the [[Siege of Blackrock Spire|Battle of Blackrock Mountain]].

Many fought on this field. Many didn't make it. Lothar...

Let me tell ye what happened all those years ago.
progress: It was such a dark day, <name>. Painful to remember.
completion:
It's a tragic story, but maybe something better can be made o' it with those fragments of Turalyon's shield.

Perhaps it can be restored--along with our friend.

title: A Worthy Forge
description:
Thank you for all your help, <name>. It's strange to hold what remains of [[Turalyon|my father]]'s [[Turalyon's shield|shield]] and know that, prior to [[Siege of Blackrock Spire|that day]], he was such a defender of others.

I feel I've only seen his aggressive side. I realize he means well, but I don't think...

That is not the path for me.

Regardless, let's return to Silvermoon and get these fragments we've gathered to a worthy forge.
progress: <Name>, I can't thank you enough for taking this journey with Arator and I.
completion:
We certainly did some good in the Burning Steppes, <name>, and recovered the fragments of Turalyon's shield.

Arator seems excited to see it reforged.

title: A Bulwark Remade
objectives: Assist Arator in reforging Turalyon's Shield
description:
<Name>, it is time to see what we can do with these fragments of Turalyon's shield.

While it did break, it was exceptionally powerful in its day, and it could be a great help to Turalyon against the [[Void]].

Perhaps a moment of healing and letting go, as well.
progress: Thank you for helping me with this, <name>.
completion:
<Name>, that did not go as I hoped, to say the least.

I'd hoped he would be able to see... to accept that he could still change.

But it doesn't look like he's open to that--at least, not now.

title: The Arcantina
description:
<Name>, there's a place that we used during the [[Second War]], when we missed our homes an' needed to remember Azeroth. Somethin' of a retreat an' a sanctuary for those who've seen too much fighting--too much pain.

Over time, we've brought friends and allies there. In recent years, members o' the Horde have been invited as well. We call it the Arcantina.

I believe Arator, and you, would benefit from some respite there. Use this key to make a portal.
progress: This really is quite the place, isn't it, <name>?
completion:
This has been a journey, <name>.

I've learned a lot from Alonsus, and the [[Sons of Lothar]]...

And perhaps most of all, what kind of paladin [[Turalyon|my father]] used to be, and what sort I'll be from now on.

title: The Journey Ends
description:
The [[Light]] takes many forms. But I know now what it means to me, and how I want to wield it.

I'm not just a weapon like [[Turalyon|my father]], nor can I devote myself purely to service like [[Sunwalker Dezco|Dezco]].

But I can protect people, from the evil that threatens them. Right now, that's [[Xal'atath]] and her [[Devouring Host]].

We should return to Lor'themar, and do whatever is needed to defeat the Void.

Beyond that, I shall see where protecting others with the Light takes me.
completion:
Thank you, <name>, for bolstering our defenders at the Sunwell.

It looks like Arator has sorted things out as well, and is ready for whatever may be ahead. It is good to have you both focused on the fight against the Void once more. 

Arator is a good man. I'm grateful we didn't lose him to this conflict.
next:
{{plainlist|
*[[Deepening Shadows (quest)]],
*[[You Know This Evil?]], or
*[[Rising Storm]]}}

title: Rising Storm
objectives: [[General Amias Bellamy|Vanguard of the Light consulted]]
description:
That was an entropic wave. We felt them just before [[Xal'atath]] launched her assault on the [[Sunwell]].

Champion, you move faster than my best messengers. I need you to check in with the [[Vanguard of the Light|Vanguard]] commanders and see if their defenses will hold against this latest assault by Xal'atath's [[Devouring Host]].
progress: Tensions are high.
completion:
Well done. That Voidstorm is evoking fear and terror in everyone who sees it, myself included. 

But I chose this life of standing up to evil and spitting in its face. Sadly not everyone had the luxury of that being a choice.

title: Magisters' Terrace: Homecoming
objectives: Meet [[Magister Umbric]] on the [[Isle of Quel'Danas]], then complete the [[Magisters' Terrace]] dungeon.
Meet Magister Umbric on the Isle of Quel'Danas
Talk to Umbric to queue for follower dungeon (Optional)
Retrieve the [[Cynosure of Twilight]] from Magisters' Terrace
Meet Magister Umbric in [[Duskglow Gloriette]] in [[Silvermoon City]].
description:
;Non-void elf
We know there's land inside the [[Voidstorm]], through its massive portal. If we can reach it, we can take the fight to [[Xal'atath]].

I have found the key. It is a relic known as the [[Cynosure of Twilight]]. For ages, it has mystified us by revealing unreachable pathways to infinite unknowns.

My research tells me I can use it to open a path to the storm.

There's just one problem: it's in [[Magisters' Terrace]]. And I'm not exactly... in their good graces, at the moment.

;Void elf
We know there's land inside the Voidstorm, through its massive portal. If we can reach it, we can take the fight to Xal'atath.

I have found the key. It is a relic known as the Cynosure of Twilight. For ages, it has mystified us by revealing unreachable pathways to infinite unknowns.

My research tells me I can use it to open a path to the storm.

There's just one problem: it's in Magister's Terrace. And as you know, <name>, we [[ren'dorei]] are not exactly... in their good graces, at the moment.
completion:
That could have gone better. 

Then again, [[Grand Magister Rommath|Rommath]] hasn't killed me, yet. It could have gone worse.
rewards:
You will be able to choose one of these rewards:
*[[Wraps of Watchful Wrath]]
*[[Custodial Cuffs]]
*[[Leggings of Orderly Conduct]]
*[[Legplates of Lingering Dusk]]
*[[Bifurcation Band]]
*[[Defiant Defender's Drape]]

You will unlock access to the following:
*Dungeon: [[Magisters' Terrace]]
*[[The Singularity]] Renown

You will also receive:
*{{Cost|134}}
*25,700 [[XP]]
*+2,500 [[reputation]] with the [[Singularity]]

title: No Fear of the Dark
objectives: Help Magister Umbric apply the anchor spell and open a portal to Voidstorm.
Stay awhile and listen to [[Lor'themar Theron|Lor'themar]] (Optional)
description:
Against all odds, we made it.

I can open a way into the storm, but it will be a tenuous connection. We can only get a small team through the portal.

We have no idea what awaits us on the other side. We must be prepared.

I can use the [[Cynosure of Twilight|Cynosure]] to bind us to [[Magisters' Terrace]]. If we need a quick escape, I can bring us back there.

Come--help me calibrate this spell.
completion:
;{{Race|VoidElf}}
This... this power! I have never felt the Void like this.

It is all-consuming. Like when we were overwhelmed in [[Telogrus Rift|Telogrus]]...

But you overcame it. We can all overcome it. We are ren'dorei.

;Other races
This... this power! I have never felt the Void like this.

All-consuming.
next: [[Save a Piece of Mind]] & [[A Matter of Strife and Death]]

title: A Matter of Strife and Death
objectives: Meet [[Lothraxion]] at the edge of [[The Ingress]].
description:
Ha! A distant realm, crawling with vicious evil monsters? Just like old times.

[[Alleria Windrunner|Alleria]], [[Turalyon]], and I faced a thousand years of war with demons in the far flung realms. It is as simple a solution now as it was then.

Kill or be killed.
progress: I will not deny, I still thrive in the rush of battle. So long as it is of righteous cause.
completion:
;Every single race
Vile beasts. Did you sense it?

They all reek of Void.

;{{Race|VoidElf}}
Vile beasts. Did you sense it?

They all reek of Void.

<Lothraxion curls his lip.>

Like you.
rewards:
You will receive:
*{{Cost|23|40}}
*12,850 [[XP]]
*[[Sturdy Void Elf Barricade]]

title: Save a Piece of Mind
description:
The Void here. It is like nothing else. Surely you can feel it, too? That overwhelming power...

We must do something to stabilize the area. I'm barely able to keep our escape route from imploding, and the rest of our scouts... I can only hope they can hold it together.

;Every single race
The ren'dorei know what to do. They will place Shadestar Loci to protect this area, but will need your help activating them.

;{{Race|VoidElf}}
Our ren'dorei know what to do. They will place Shadestar Loci to protect this area, but will need your help activating them.
progress: Be careful, <class>. Treachery threatens us from all sides.
completion:
;Every single race
The void elves risk corruption, and yet are most suited to understanding the world around us. We need their expertise, but cannot trust them.

It irks me, but I have already sent for more scouts.

All-consuming.

;{{Race|VoidElf}}
You void elves risk corruption, and yet are most suited to understanding the world around us.

We need your expertise, but cannot trust you.

It irks me, but I have already sent for more scouts.
rewards:
You will receive one of:
*[[Hazy Penumbral Mitts]]
*[[Gauntlets of Infinite Gravity]]
*[[Neverending Vortex Striders]]
*[[Grips of the Colossal Behemoths]]

You will also receive:
*{{Cost|23|40}}
*12,850 [[XP]]

title: The Far, Far Frontier
objectives: Survey Voidstorm with Lothraxion and [[Arator the Redeemer|Arator]].
description:
We have secured this location. Some void elves can make this into a proper camp.

There must be some weakness we can exploit to stop the storm. We must bring my army here to mete out justice to [[Xal'atath]]'s armies!

Join me and young [[Arator the Redeemer|Arator]]. Let us see what we can gather from this place across the horizon.
completion:
The rest of the void elves have been dispersed to set up camps or scout.

I am... conflicted over Alleria's presence. Her skills and experience are unspeakably valuable, and yet...

The Void in her is so strong... I worry. Keep an eye on her.

The Void can NEVER be trusted.

;Void elf
The rest of your fellow void elves have been dispersed to set up camps or scout.

I am... conflicted over Alleria's presence. Much like you, her skills and experience are unspeakably valuable, and yet...

Even moreso than you, the Void in her is so strong... I worry. Keep an eye on her.

The Void can NEVER be trusted.
prev: [[Save a Piece of Mind]] & [[A Matter of Strife and Death]]

title: A Strange, Different World
objectives: Collect 12 Shadowgraft Fragments in Nexus-Point Antius.
description:
I don't know the purpose of these towers, only that they are called Nexus-Points and they thrum with Void power. We must get more information. 

The domanaar use some kind of Void-infused metal on the beasts here to add them to armies of the Devouring Host. They call it shadowgrafting.

It empowers them, but also influences their minds.

<Alleria smiles wryly.> 

What power doesn't? 

I have a plan for it. With you here, I can finally act on it.
progress: The metal on these creatures... it seems particularly conductive to magical energies. Interesting.
completion:
<Lothraxion scowls.>

Despicable stuff. Alleria has explained her plan to me, but I'm not sure I agree.

title: Dancing with Death
objectives: Slay Voidgrasper, Vathan the Rebel, and Scytheryp the Slicer in [[Nexus-Point Antius]].
description:
We may be a small strike team, but we are strong. We have you, after all. 

There is no need to move with complete stealth. We must cut a path to the domanaar here. 

Take down the strongest enemies you can find. We will join you in the fray.
progress: Have you found the greatest of the enemies here? I wonder just how powerful a creature can get, consuming Void for eternity...
completion:
There seems to be creatures here both bestial and magical.

The Void is drawn to violence. I have seen countless worlds drown in it.

Could the savagery of the beasts here have brought the Void in naturally?

title: No Prayer for the Wicked
objectives: Help modify the Shadowgraft Fragments, slay Sinewshredder in [[Nexus-Point Antius]], and capture the leading domanaar.
Stay awhile and listen to Alleria (Optional)
Meet Alleria, Lothraxion, and Arator at The Ingress.
description:
Alleria has a plan to use this shadowgrafting material to capture that domanaar for information.

But what good is information given by evil? I've fought countless demons and every one of them was a liar.

<Lothraxion scowls.>

Let us follow her plan, for now. Do what she asks with this metal, then slay the domanaar's pet beast.

Once we speak with this vile creature, I will decide how long it lives.
completion: You've done good work, <name>.

title: Reliable Enemies
objectives: Meet up at the overlook above the [[Ethereum Refinery]].
description:
The ren'dorei scouts report a familiar enemy upon this world. [[Ethereal]]s. Wretched scavengers and bandits that plague every corner of the [[Great Dark Beyond]]. The [[Shadowguard]] are the worst of them. We'll handle them.

This... thing we've taken prisoner must know what they're doing here, and much else. Press the Void's secrets from it. See that it is convinced to share what it knows, or I will employ my own methods.
progress: Lothraxion has a plan. I trust him.
completion:
If Xal'atath was mortal, then she is all the more monstrous for all that she has done. For becoming what she is now.

Our long battle comes to an end on this world. I swear it.

title: Work Disruption
objectives: Slay Shadowguard and disrupt the Manaforge at the [[Ethereum Refinery]].
Find Alleria deeper in the Ethereum Refinery.
description:
The [[Shadowguard]] may once have defied [[Xal'atath]], but they're part of her army now. Whatever they're doing with the energies gathered here must be stopped.

Put down their soldiers, harvesters, and machines. I'll do the same, and meet you deeper within.
progress: What does she have planned...
completion: They will try to rebuild, but we won't give them the chance.
rewards:
You will receive:
*{{Cost|23|40}}
*14,135 [[XP]]
*[[Sturdy Void Elf Crate]]

title: Overwhelmed
description:
We were too late. All of the strength between us wasn't enough.

<Arator looks over his shoulder, wary. Then, he crouches and places his hand on [[Alleria Windrunner|Alleria]]'s shoulder. She responds only with a ragged exhale.>

Let's fall back. The ren'dorei have been exploring the wilds while we've been following [[Lothraxion]]. We might be able to find their encampment nearby.
completion: Even the power of a naaru wasn't enough...

title: First, The Shells
objectives: Collect 5 Empty Manacells from mechs and ethereals at the [[Ethereum Refinery]].
Stay Awhile and Listen to Lothraxion (Optional)
Find Lothraxion deeper in the Ethereum Refinery.
description:
Ages ago, on a dismal world of swamp, I led the [[Army of the Light]] to a demon-infested manaforge obscured by vines and fog. My soldiers left that world in a haze of flame and smoke, the scent of burning mana and victory in the air. We will do now as we did then.

We'll begin by collecting the empty canisters they use to hold and transport fuel. The [[ethereal]]s, and especially their automatons, will have them.
progress: Just as before.
completion:
Good. The same make I remember. 

Now, the catalyst.
rewards:
You will receive one of:
*[[Beacon of the Cold Flame]]
*[[Darkness-Infused Polearms]]
*[[Dagger of the Eternal Void]]
*[[Iron Fists of the Eternal Void]]
*[[Shield of Desolation]]
*[[Void-Touched Baton]]
*[[Bow of the Great Dark]]
*[[Darkslayer's Sword]]
*[[Axe of the Great Dark]]

You will also receive:
*[[Open Sturdy Void Elf Trunk]]
*{{Cost|23|40}}
*14,135 [[XP]]

title: A Cracked Holokey
objectives: Bring the Cracked Holokey to [[Alleria]] deeper in the [[Ethereum Refinery]].
description:
<A unique-looking ethereal device rests upon the cold ground. It bears a crack down the middle from damage in a scuffle.

Perhaps Alleria will know what it is.>
completion:
I've seen one of these before. Ethereals use them to encrypt communications.

Excellent find, <name>.

title: Second, The Fuel
objectives: Collect 50 Arcane Remnants in the Ethereum Refinery.
description:
Ethereals seek corners of the cosmos to drain of potent nether. Arcane, Void, fel--to them, it matters only the yield. And we have a rich vein to work with.

Now, slay those who possess that energy: wild arcane elementals from their pipes, or their ethereal harvesters flush with energy. We have need of it.
progress: Go. Collect the catalyst.
completion: Potent. I can feel the energy--radiant. Glorious.

title: Network Insecurity
objectives: Use the holokey on consoles around the Ethereum Refinery.
description:
Judging by the design and the strength of this holokey's energy, it must be used to encrypt important communications.

Let us try this lead. See if it's compatible with any of the consoles you find around the refinery. Given the damage it's taken, we'll have to piece together whatever scraps of information we can.
progress: What have you found?
completion:
Xal'atath.

Let us see this final message.

title: Agents of Darkness
objectives: Slay [[Nexus-King Salhadaar]]'s lieutenants within [[Nexus Point Mid'ar]].
Meet with Alleria within the ethereal installation at Nexus-Point Mid'Ar.
description:
When that shield goes down, [[Xal'atath]]'s forces will be upon us in droves. If I'm going to detonate those manacells from afar, I'll need an opening. Thin the [[Devouring Host]] of their strongest, and the rest of Xal'atath's lackeys will be easier to fight off.

We will make sure the shield goes down in the meantime. Good luck, <name>.
progress: Have you taken them out?
completion: I hope Xal'atath was watching. It'll be her turn soon.

title: A Naaru!
objectives: Find [[Lothraxion]] at the overlook to [[Nexus-Point Mid'Ar]].
description:
I refuse to let another [[naaru]] fall to darkness.

Before our departure, the scouts reported they had found a Nexus-Point connected to this forge. If the Void's forces possess a naaru, it might be where they're keeping it.

I will prepare the manacells as we conduct the search. Come.
completion: A naaru, imprisoned. The [[Light]] shall give these monsters no mercy.
next: [[Third, Blow It Up]], [[Just In Case...]], & [[Agents of Darkness]]

title: Third, Blow It Up
objectives: Place 5 Overcharged Manacells at Nexus-Point Mid'Ar.
Meet with Lothraxion within the ethereal installation at Nexus-Point Mid'Ar.
description:
The manacells have been prepared. Set them near the pylon and its supporting machinery. When it's done, I will command [[Alleria Windrunner|Alleria]] to ignite them from afar.

But we cannot proceed until the naaru has been brought to safety. Go now and I will make certain of her freedom.
progress: What are you doing here? Place the manacells, now!
completion: This is taking too long! Every wasted moment brings us closer to ruin!

title: Just In Case...
objectives: Collect 8 Fragmented Keystones from [[Devouring Host]] soldiers at [[Nexus-Point Mid'Ar]].
Meet with Decimus within the ethereal installation at Nexus-Point Mid'Ar.
description:
Perhaps [[Lothraxion]] will be able to bring that shield down on his own. Or perhaps he is a pompous blowhard.

The Devouring Host offers its trusted soldiers fragments of a relic that can override any ethereal device, including that shield. You'll need to carve quite a swath through their forces to recover enough shards.

But what do I know? I am merely unworthy [[Void-spawn|voidspawn]].
progress: <Decimus glances sideways at you.>
completion:
A mortal, receptive to outside ideas. Truly exemplary. No need to thank me.

Though, perhaps you'd want to free me of this bondage? I'm feeling a bit chafed by the Light about now.

No? Oh well.

title: Flicker in the Dark
description:
We're dawdling! There's no time to waste!

Get that shield down, now! T'era's anguish tears at my soul!
completion: Everything I could muster. It was simply... devoured.
prev: [[Third, Blow It Up]], [[Just In Case...]], & [[Agents of Darkness]]

title: Post-Mortem
objectives: Check in with the inhabitants of Locus Point.
Stay Awhile and Listen to [[Alleria Windrunner|Alleria]] (Optional)
description:
We all bear a heavy burden in this place. I feel myself slipping towards hopelessness. But we haven't failed until we refuse to stand back up. I know my mother will collect herself. But the others need to know this fight isn't over.

Speak with Hieron. He and the other scouts should have information. We can start there.
progress: Mother... Hang in there.
completion: What was that...?

title: The Light's Brand
objectives: Intervene in the fight between [[Lothraxion]] and [[Decimus]].
Find Lothraxion and Decimus on the outskirts of Locus Point
Speak to Arator to receive healing (Optional)
Gather and deliver Burning Light to Arator (15)
description:
No! <name>, we have to stop them! Lothraxion's boiling temper risks everything! That he chooses now of all times, when my mother is out of commission...

There's no time. We have to go!
progress: I should have realized earlier... Join me. <name>, Let us reveal the truth.
completion: Decimus is a far more capable domanaar than they've been letting on.

title: Friend or Fiend
objectives: Stay a while and listen to [[Lothraxion]] (Optional)
description:
Despite that spirited display, I'm inclined to help you. After all, what's a little violence between friends? 

And since we're friends, I'll let you in on a secret: shutting down the storm is only possible from inside the Nexus-Points. Of course you can't just walk in--you need the Mantle of Predation.

<Decimus seems to savor the words.>

Do I have your attention? Let's shake the dust off and discuss this somewhere... civilized. Meet me at my estate.
completion: Guests are a rare treat for a domanaar. Especially ones that come of their own accord.

title: Domus Penumbra
objectives: Establish your base at the [[Howling Ridge]].
description:
It seems we all wish to stop the [[Voidstorm]]. Common ground--a rare thing here. I'll even tell you how to do it, and all I ask in return is for you to let me enjoy the show.

But you must be tired. Show yourself around, and help yourself to the amenities. Then we will continue our discussion.

Don't take too long. There is much to see, and the storm rages on.
progress: Have you met my pets? I assure you, they're harmless. Unless, of course, they're hungry.
completion:
Comfortable? So nice to see someone appreciate my hospitality.

Now I suppose we must discuss business before your glowing friend has another tantrum.

title: The Lay of the Beast
objectives: Use Decimus's pet to scout the Voidspire.
Stay a while and listen to [[Arator the Redeemer|Arator]]
description:
Your friend's scheme to blow up the Nexus-Point was adorable. You all looked so determined, I didn't have the heart to tell you how simple the solution really is.

The Mantle of Predation will allow you to enter the Nexus-Points and weaken the storm. Alas, it's claiming the Mantle that will truly test you.

Borrow my pet--see through his eyes. I'll show you who you'll steal the Mantle from.
progress: Go on. Ciphus won't mind.
completion:
There you have it--simply steal the Mantle from Terminas. I'd recommend acting quickly. Who knows when Terminas will return to the Obscurion Citadel.

A shame about Ciphus. I was planning to devour him myself once I'd fattened him up.

title: Face the Tide
description:
I expected an army, but this is chaos. Beasts pouring from the Void, gorging themselves, taking captives for sport.

Our mission is to claim the Mantle, but we can't ignore this. Sooner or later, these forces will be loosed against [[Silvermoon City|Silvermoon]]. Any blows we strike now will save lives down there, <name>.

Starve their forces, stem the flow of beasts from the Void, and free every captive they've abducted.
progress: Even if we fail--Light forfend--at least we'll have struck a blow.
completion: This is what [[Alleria Windrunner|my mother]] has battled on her own for all these years? I won't let her shoulder that burden alone any more.

title: Edge of the Abyss
objectives: Meet the ren'dorei scouts near the [[Obscurion Citadel]].
Meet the ren'dorei scouts by the [[Obscurion Citadel]].
description:
I don't trust [[Decimus]] any more than the rest of the beasts here. I do trust that they only serve themself. Seems having [[Xal'atath]] as a master isn't to their taste. We can turn one foe against another. Even Lothraxion would agree if he weren't so stubborn.

If this [[Mantle of Predation]] will let us stop the storm then it's our best shot. A troop of ren'dorei have been scouting the Obscurion Citadel. We'll meet with them and see what they've learned.
progress: I've avoided this place until now. The howls and the stench are carried on the wind like a warning.
completion:
I don't like dividing our forces. Not when this much is at stake.

Let's not rush in like [[Lothraxion]]. See what Decimus knows. I'd rather not hunt a domanaar unprepared.

title: The Harvest
objectives: Slay foes to attract Torentia's attention.
description:
Two sigils, you'll need both to open [[Terminas]]' vault and claim the mantle.

The first belongs to [[Torentia]], petty ruler of this sad trench. Too ambitious for Terminas to bring her into his inner circle, too cowardly to strike out on her own. So here she cowers behind an unbreakable shield of void.

She's terrified of losing her already meager holdings. What a pity. Slaughter your way through the trench, the potential emergence of a new apex predator is something she won't ignore.
progress: Do you feel the hunger of this place? No wonder the Void came here.
completion: Do you sense it? Every beast here either fears you or wants to kill you. Even their mistress cannot ignore you now.

title: Lady of the Pit
objectives: {{Questportrait|Torentia.jpg|Torentia|A canny and cautious domanaar. Torentia avoids fights unless she feels her authority is threatened.}}
Challenge Torentia and claim her sigil to access the vault.
Regroup with Alleria Windrunner in the upper Obscurion Citadel.
description:
For all their power, these domanaar still behave like beasts. That's good for us. Wolves try to avoid each other, but if one threatens another's territory, they'll fight to the death.

By now, I think you've more than proven that you're a threat. Torentia can't back down if you challenge her--it would go against her nature.

So take the fight to her, slay her, and claim her sigil.
progress: Have you claimed Torentia's sigil?
completion:
I've never known [[Lothraxion]] to be careless like this. Throwing lives away, charging in blind--doesn't he know he's not leading an army here?

At least you've done your part. Let's try to salvage the mission.
rewards:
You will receive:
*{{Cost|46|80}}
*17,875 [[XP]]
*+100 [[reputation]] with [[The Singularity]] <!-- wb bonus -->

One from:
*[[Hazy Penumbral Guards]]
*[[Bracelets of Infinite Gravity]]
*[[Neverending Vortex Vambraces]]
*[[Unbroken Armplates of the Colossal Behemoths]]
next: [[All Become Prey]], [[Vanished in the Void]], & [[Hollow Hunger]]

title: Hollow Hunger
objectives: {{Questportrait|Severum.jpg|Severum|Severum's intense hunger has helped him claw his way up the food chain.}}
description:
[[Alleria Windrunner|Alleria]]'s judgement is clouded. She's spent too much time steeped in Void. I've prosecuted campaigns across the cosmos. Casualties are inevitable. I could not command if the loss of every soldier broke my will.

We have the information we need: the location of the sigil bearer. The fiends whisper of a domanaar named Severum. Slay him and take his sigil, then we can be rid of this place.
progress: Would that we could put every voidspawn to the sword.
completion:
Well done. Soon we'll have the Mantle of Predation and no longer need Decimus.

Do not mistake their usefulness for allegiance as Alleria has.

title: All Become Prey
objectives: Slay Slavering Ultradons by marking them with Carrion Essence.
Gather Carrion Essence from slain creatures to weaken ultradons (Optional)
description:
[[Lothraxion]]'s acting like we have an army, but a single ultradon will tear through us if we're caught off guard. We need to be smarter.

I've watched the beasts of this world: studied them, tracked them, killed them. They prey on weakness, and cull their own kind at the first sign of frailty.

Harvest Carrion Essence from the carcasses around the citadel. Use it to mark ultradons. Other beasts will pounce, thinking they're wounded or dying. Let them tear each other apart, then clean up what's left.
progress: These creatures operate on base instinct. We can exploit that.
completion: Good hunting. With the ultradons dead, we may just be able to get out of here alive.

title: Vanished in the Void
description:
"Acceptable losses," I hope I never find it that easy to dismiss the deaths of friends and comrades. What use is the light if it leaves us as callous as our enemies?

Sideras was nearly killed. Luckily he escaped through a rift. Riftblade Maella led the others in a fighting retreat. Find her, hopefully they stuck together.

I can't leave Sideras, not until he's stable.
progress: Lothraxion should know better than this.
completion:
This isn't right, Hieron didn't come here to die. The Light should protect people, not lead them to their deaths.

<Arator seems lost in thought.>

Thank you. I'll make sure to give his journal to the others.

title: The Mantle of Predation
objectives: Speak to Alleria when you're ready
description:
Let's move quickly. We need to steal the Mantle before [[Terminas]] returns and before [[Lothraxion]] does something rash.

I understand this place grates on him, but he should know to trust my instincts. I thought we'd fought together long enough to earn that.

Let's end this. Ready when you are.
completion: Are you alright? I must have missed something. Why did [[Decimus]] bother helping us at all? They could have betrayed us at any time. It doesn't make any sense...
prev: [[All Become Prey]], [[Vanished in the Void]], & [[Hollow Hunger]]

title: Abyssus, Abyssum
description:
I don't see [[Decimus]]. For all their glee at handing us over, I'd expect they'd want to watch the fight. What could be more important to a [[domanaar]] than enjoying a battle?

<Alleria nocks another arrow.>

Answers can wait. Right now we need to survive.
completion: [[Lothraxion]]'s going to tear the nexus-points apart even if it costs us [[Silvermoon]]!

title: Hunt the Light
description: There's no time, [[Lothraxion]] already has the lead. Get to Nexus-Point Xenas, <name>, we'll meet you there.
completion: He's already here, we have to stop him.

title: Nexus-Point Xenas: Eclipse
objectives: {{questportrait|Lothraxion (Nexus-Point Xenas).png|Lothraxion|Lothraxion's righteous fury puts Silvermoon and all its people at risk. He must be stopped.}}
Talk to Alleria to queue for follower dungeon (Optional)
Stay a while and listen to Alleria (Optional)
Enter Nexus-Point Xenas and stop Lothraxion
description:
If he destroys the Nexus-Point, everyone we're fighting for could perish. I'll try to talk him down, but if I can't, if I have to...

<Alleria's face clouds.>

No hesitation. We end this, one way or another.
progress: We've come too far to let anything stop us.
completion: It's over. We can breathe, if only for a moment.
rewards:
You will be able to choose one of these rewards:
*[[Occlusion of Void]]
*[[Omission of Light]]
*[[Fluxweave Cloak]]

You will also receive:
*{{Cost|96|60}}
*28,545 [[XP]]
*[[Smoldering Energy Forge]]
*+250 [[reputation]] with [[The Singularity]]

title: Daylight is Breaking
objectives: Report to Lor'themar Theron in the Sanctum of Light in Silvermoon City.
description:
[[Turalyon]] is busying himself with the troops. We'll need to let him know what they'll face here, tell him about [[Lothraxion]]...

<Alleria shakes her head.>

Thank you, <name>. Even when my thoughts feel clouded you never seem to waver. Go, give Lor'themar my report. Arator and I will brief Turalyon.
completion:
This was an impossible mission. We won't forget the sacrifices that bought us a fighting chance.

Still, I know not every victory feels worthy of celebration. When war forces us to choose between friendship and duty, there are many who would be unable to act.

We will not squander the opportunity you've given us. Now, our counter offensive begins.

title: The Last Push
objectives: Quests in [[Silvermoon City]], [[Eversong Woods]], [[Zul'Aman|Zul'aman]]{{sic}}, [[Harandar]], and [[Voidstorm]] will now scale to your level.
description:
Our forces are starting to move out to take the fight to [[Xal'atath]]. 

I've received word there are many areas that you've visited that could still use some aid. 

We must focus our attention on the counter offensive. Can you help those that are in need?
progress: There's plenty out there that can be done.
completion:
Fine work <name>. 

There's plenty to do now that you've taken care of those issues.

title: Deepening Shadows
description:
Champion, I could use your assistance. The natives here in Silvermoon are proving to be less hospitable than we had hoped. 

In their defense, their city is facing down a darkness unlike anything [[Azeroth]] has ever faced, so tensions are high.

Can you use your unique perspective and help de-escalate some of the hot spots that are emerging around Silvermoon?
progress: Tensions are high.
completion:
Well done. That [[Voidstorm]] is evoking fear and terror in everyone who sees it, myself included. 

But I chose this life of standing up to evil and spitting in its face. Sadly not everyone had the luxury of that being a choice.

title: You Know This Evil?
objectives: Negotiate with the [[Vanguard of the Light]] for [[Magister Umbric]]'s release.
description:
Champion, we have a bit of a delicate situation.

The [[Vanguard of the Light]] has just informed me they have taken [[Magister Umbric]] into custody. Apparently he was trying to get close to the [[Sunwell]].

I do not have to tell you that tensions are high between [[Silvermoon City|my city]] and the Vanguard. We need Umbric to continue his research if we are to have a chance at contending with the [[Voidstorm]].

I want you to represent me in negotiating Umbric's release. Whether we like him or not, we need him.
progress:
Umbric is necessary. So is the Vanguard.

I have a lot of necessary and unsavory elements to deal with these days, but I will do so if it means my people are safe.
completion: Thank you for your intercession. While I pride myself on doing what is necessary for Silvermoon and the Sunwell, I have a feeling my own patience would have worn thin and I would have said something that all of us would have regretted.

title: Reports Returned
objectives: Report to Lor'themar Theron in Silvermoon City.
description:
I will go to Silvermoon but... I will return here to advise Zul'jarra.

I feel I let my past and my prejudices get in the way of my judgement regarding the Amani. You could say that being a hash'ura is a befitting atonement but... I feel drawn to stay, perhaps to help Zul'jarra in guiding her people back to the loa.

I will go to Silvermoon with you to bear the report--and Lor'themar's reaction.

If we go now, we may return to... party.

<A small smile cracks Liadrin's usually stoic face.>
completion:
<Lor'themar raises an eyebrow and frowns slightly. You can tell he is fighting back exasperation and anger.>

This is a... very unexpected turn of events. Yet still more will unfold in front of us, I'm sure.
rewards:
You will receive:
*[[Banner of the Amani Tribe]]
*{{cost|2|34}}
*1,705 [[XP]]
next:
{{plainlist|
*[[Deepening Shadows (quest)]],
*[[You Know This Evil?]], or
*[[Rising Storm]]}}

title: Looming Shadows
objectives: Return to Regent Lord [[Lor'themar Theron]] in the [[Sanctum of Light (Silvermoon City)|Sanctum of Light]] in [[Silvermoon City]].
description:
Though we've triumphed over [[Ruia]] and the [[Lightbloom]] for now, more remains to be done. The elders will want to convene regarding the [[Hara'ti]]'s new place in the world, now that we have stepped out from the shadows of our past.

Our reticence and fear will not vanish overnight. But this is an important first step.

We will be fine, <name>. Let [[Orweyna]] and I deal with the elders. When the time comes, the Hara'ti shall be at your side. For now, though, I'd imagine you have more pressing matters to attend to.
completion:
When [[Halduron Brightwing|Halduron]] burst into a war council shouting about hidden worlds and ancient warriors, I thought he had gone mad. But now that I've seen the [[haranir]] with my own eyes...

We are lucky to have them as potential allies. And lucky to have you, I'd say, in brokering that relationship.

There is more for us to do. But I've no doubt that the Hara'ti will prove vital allies to Silvermoon in the days to come.
next:
{{plainlist|
*[[Deepening Shadows (quest)]],
*[[You Know This Evil?]], or
*[[Rising Storm]]}}
